paper.title: Joint sufficient dimension reduction and estimation of conditional and average treatment effects
paper.source_version: Published typeset article plus author supplementary material asx028_supp.pdf from Europe PMC deposit PMC5793490
paper.source_locator: Supplement asx028_supp.pdf Section 3.1, PDF/printed p.4, unnumbered Setting 1 and Setting 2 paragraphs; Section 3.4 PDF/printed p.6 for both reported ATEs = 1; main article Section 2.1 PDF p.3 / journal p.585 for estimand and assumptions; collected second setting

mechanism.name: 变换观测特征与潜在正态线性结果
mechanism.title_en: Transformed Gaussian covariates and latent-linear outcomes
generation_equations: Y(1)=1+Z1+epsilon1; Y(0)=Z2+epsilon0; epsilon0,epsilon1 as defined in the same paragraph, N(0,1/10) independently; Y=A*Y(1)+(1-A)*Y(0).

latent_variables.name: Z1,...,Z10
latent_variables.identification_note: Z1=2log(X1), Z2=X2*(1+X1**2); both outcome-active latent coordinates are recoverable. No additional unobserved confounder.

sampling.dependence: Three observed covariates affect assignment/outcomes. Do not add +10 to X2 and do not square X4: those are different Kang–Schafer variants, not this source. Internal Z1–Z3 are not learner inputs. Noise definition is inherited from the immediately preceding sentence; this explicit scope interpretation is flagged for human review. Independent treatment/noise random draws conditional on covariates; no clusters or panel structure.

assumptions: Consistency and no interference across independent individuals.
Conditional exchangeability given observed baseline X under the declared synthetic assignment.
Pointwise positivity; no uniform overlap bound claimed for unbounded Gaussian logistic settings.

properties.notes: Three observed covariates affect assignment/outcomes. Do not add +10 to X2 and do not square X4: those are different Kang–Schafer variants, not this source. Internal Z1–Z3 are not learner inputs. Noise definition is inherited from the immediately preceding sentence; this explicit scope interpretation is flagged for human review.

estimand.name: ATE
estimand.definition: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the full declared covariate population; treatment 1 versus 0; population, not sample-conditional, target.

truth.expression: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the full declared covariate population; treatment 1 versus 0; population, not sample-conditional, target.
truth.derivation: E[Z1]=E[Z2]=0, so ATE=1. Conditional means in observed coordinates are 1+2*log(X1) and X2*(1+X1**2). Thus mean exchangeability can be stated given observed X; latent generation does not imply hidden confounding here.

adaptations: Source treatment indicator is named A in the observed output; no scientific change.
Independently implemented Python/NumPy sampler; source estimator fitting and large simulation replications are outside this collection task.
Setting 2 epsilon definitions are read as inherited from Setting 1 in the same paragraph; this explicitly documented scope reading needs human confirmation.
